question: Among superheroes taller than 80% of the average height, what percentage have blue eyes and are published by Marvel Comics? Also, return the name of the least intelligent superhero in this tall group.

prediction.sql:
WITH tall AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_018, s.XCL_019, s.XCL_022, s.XCL_026
  FROM superhero AS s
  WHERE s.XCL_028 > 0.8 * (SELECT AVG(XCL_028) FROM superhero)
),
tall_int AS (
  SELECT t.XCL_018, t.XCL_019, ha.XCL_011 AS intelligence
  FROM tall AS t
  JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON t.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
  JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
  WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Intelligence'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tall AS t
    JOIN colour AS c ON t.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    JOIN publisher AS p ON t.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = 'Blue' AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics') * 100.0 /
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tall) AS percentage,
  (SELECT XCL_019 FROM tall_int ORDER BY intelligence ASC LIMIT 1) AS least_intelligent_name

  SELECT t.XCL_018, t.XCL_019, ha.XCL_011 AS intelligence

  JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON t.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
  JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
  WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Intelligence'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tall AS t
    JOIN colour AS c ON t.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    JOIN publisher AS p ON t.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = 'Blue' AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics') * 100.0 /
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tall) AS percentage,
  (SELECT XCL_019 FROM tall_int ORDER BY intelligence ASC LIMIT 1) AS least_intelligent_name

    JOIN publisher p ON t.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
